# Emmental

> A free, lightweight macOS menu bar app for tuning your mouse: speed, acceleration and scroll
> speed for any mouse, plus sensor DPI, SmartShift and battery level on Logitech MX mice like the
> MX Master 3S. Under 25 MB of memory. No background updater, no account, no tracking.

## Key facts
- macOS 12 or later. Lives in the menu bar; no Dock icon, no background services.
- Acceleration up to 8.0, past the 3.0 limit in System Settings, set per mouse.
- Scroll speed per mouse.
- Logitech features (optional, need Input Monitoring permission): DPI 200–8000, SmartShift
  free-spin threshold, battery level, and high-resolution scrolling. Uses
  Logitech's HID++ 2.0 protocol over Bluetooth, with early support for Bolt and Unifying receivers.
- Settings are reapplied at login, after sleep and when the mouse reconnects.
- No analytics. It only goes online when you click "Check for Updates" (reads a small version file
  from the website) or "Install Update" (downloads the new version from GitHub) in Settings.
- A lightweight alternative to Logi Options+ for people who only need speed, scrolling and
  SmartShift. It does not do button remapping or gestures.

## Links
- Home and download: https://emmental.artichoke.monster/
